snapshots.name: Hyperlocal Temperature Monitoring
snapshots.description: As a part of the Cool Neighborhoods Initiative, the NYC Parks Department, Mayor’s Office of Resilience and NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene monitored street level temperature on a subset of city blocks in some of the neighborhoods with highest heat mortality risk during the summers of 2018 and 2019. The dataset includes hourly average values at approximately 475 locations in degrees Fahrenheit.
snapshots.attribution: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene (DOHMH)
